late_twilight_visual_original.claimed_data: Plotted naked-eye star appearance for stars including iota Coronae Borealis V=4.99 and iota Lyrae V=5.28, around solar depressions beyond 10.5deg (roughly 12-14deg by graphical inspection); plotted values were NOT per-event tabular timestamps
late_twilight_visual_original.quantitative_admission: NOT_ACCEPTED_AS_EXACT_OBSERVED_TIMES__no date/time per plotted point, no original raw log/no independent aerosol or cloud profile
late_twilight_visual_original.precision_statement: Paper printed page 57 reports faint-star first-appearance time determination may exceed ten minutes uncertainty, versus about two minutes for bright stars; those are authors' general estimates, not verified statistical prediction error.

material_internal_published_formula_conf.conflicts: Sign of intercept in (3a), 6.61 vs 5.61 in (3b), and magnitude-side branch inequalities disagree with Figure 4 and the asserted transition at m~4.2. material_internal_published_formula_conf.source_of_example: algebra only, NOT newly measured first-sighting or our model error
